TOOLING BURST FL-6 — DANCING FLAMES: a three-layer flame parallax on every painted flame body (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt R-C5-128: "three layers of flames where the second and third alternate movement shifts at a rather random jitter pattern to impose a dancing flame feeling" — the mechanism of the scenery parallax, turned inward). task_id "FL-6".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a (material), T4h (burst_v2), FL-3 (boil), FL-4b (interleave), FL-4c, FL-5 and the new row "FL-6 — dancing flames (three-layer flame parallax)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (burst_v2 pieces phase: body shards, interleave tongues, core; the G1 painted projectile: head + flame sheet; the G2 painted pool + licks; the FL-3 boil uniforms), export/effect_kit.py, export/parallax_scene.py (read the parallax layer model only for its shape: layers with independent rates), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json, fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json, blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json, runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

WHY (Matt R-C5-130: "I am not seeing the interleaves whatsoever"): the interleave tongues exist (FL-4b/FL-5 traces: 5-7 per cast, gaps <= 40 deg) but are ILLEGIBLE: same four planes as the arms, rooted at the core rim under the arms, flying with the same rule, alive 0.4 s — they read as "fuller", never as separate flames, and a per-cast silhouette difference cannot be perceived in 0.4 s. Real fire's randomness is perceived through TIME (flicker/dance), not through one-frame differences. So the dance mechanism ABSORBS the interleave: the tongues become the FRONT dancing layer, moving and flickering on their own clock, extending beyond the arm silhouette, with their own hot core.

THE MECHANISM (one shared block, `flame_dance`, usable by any painted flame body; defaults OFF so every other kit is byte-identical): a painted flame body is drawn as THREE LAYERS — L1 the BASE: the body as today (arms + core piece), no jitter; L2 the BACK layer: a copy of the body's outer planes (bands 0-1) at 0.94 scale drawn BEHIND L1 (z -1), dancing; L3 the FRONT layer: for the fire burst, THE INTERLEAVE TONGUES THEMSELVES (not a copy) drawn IN FRONT of L1 (z +1), rooted at 1.25x the core rim so they extend BEYOND the arm silhouette, count 6-8, scale 1.3-1.7x, each with an additive band-3 hot core (alpha .5, 4-px blur) so they read as separate licks; for bodies without interleaves (the flight sheet, the pool licks) L3 = a copy of the inner planes (bands 2-3) at 1.04, alpha .85. L2 and L3 each move on their OWN seeded clock: every `step_frames` (drawn from {2,3} per step, seeded) the layer picks a new offset — translation ±`jitter_px` (5), rotation ±`jitter_deg` (2.5) about the body pivot, scale ±`jitter_scale` (.03) — and eases toward it (no snap); L2 and L3 alternate in opposing senses; the walk is a seeded bounded random walk (never a pulse train: assert no autocorrelation peak > 0.5 beyond lag 0). L3 tongues ADDITIONALLY flicker: per-tongue scale ±8 % and alpha .85-1.0 on a turbulent 3.3-3.6 Hz clock (the Blackwater lick clock, seeded per tongue). All layers share L1's erosion/dissolve progress and die with it. Per-cast seeding chooses the tongue set AND every clock's phase — no two casts match in silhouette OR in motion. Fields: `flame_dance {layers 3, back_scale .94, front_scale 1.04, front_alpha .85, front_source "interleave"|"inner_planes", tongue_root_radius_factor 1.25, tongue_count [6,8], tongue_scale [1.3,1.7], tongue_core_alpha .5, jitter_px 5, jitter_deg 2.5, jitter_scale .03, step_frames [2,3], flicker_hz [3.3,3.6], seed_offset 7}`, validated with ranges. Painted life: the spent key state moves from age 24 to 28 (4 more frames of dance; the ember ending still carries the tail; total life unchanged ≤ 1.9 s).
LEGIBILITY CLAUSE (the point of the burst): in a headless 1080p gl_compatibility capture of the east cast at ages 14, 18, 22, the L3 tongues' painted pixels OUTSIDE the L1 silhouette (dilated 3 px) are ≥ 15 % of L1's painted area on every sampled frame, and ≥ 4 tongues each have ≥ 60 % of their pixels outside it — i.e. the flames between the arms are visibly SEPARATE flames.

APPLY to: (1) the fire burst body `fire_burst_e0p_v3` (L1 = peak-01 body pieces + core; L3 = the interleave tongues per above); (2) the fire bolt's FLAME SHEET in flight (fire_bolt_e1_A/B `travel.flame_dance`, jitter_px 4 — the wake dances while it flies); (3) Blackwater's pool licks (`blackwater_cocktail_e3` field licks, jitter_px 3, step_frames [3,5] — slower, a burning pool) — three kits' kit.json only; primitives byte-identical; ice and the rest untouched.
Trace clauses: the LEGIBILITY clause above; for the east fire cast at ages 12–28, L2/L3 offsets differ from L1 on ≥ 90 % of frames and from each other in sign on ≥ 70 % of frames; the offset series' autocorrelation has no peak > 0.5 beyond lag 0 over a 60-frame pool-lick sample; layers vanish with L1 (no L2/L3 pixel after the body's last painted frame); frame time cost reported (three draws of the body at 1080p compat: report ms on the headless trace, must stay ≤ 1.5× the single-layer cost).
PART D — byte locks re-opened (FL-1b diff rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-6/acceptance.json): the trace clauses with numbers per applied body; 15 kits byte-identical; full 18-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): field validation; the layer/jitter/autocorrelation clauses; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, export/parallax_scene.py, any kit except the three named kit.json files, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-6/ and the spec's named fields; fixtures/ only for Part D. No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-6/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-6"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
